required_topics: Understanding human trafficking and its impact on the hospitality industry
Identifying potential signs of human trafficking among employees
Legal protections afforded to individuals making good faith reports of trafficking
Roles and responsibilities in reporting and responding to human trafficking incidents
recordkeeping_requirements: Records of completed trainings for each employee, available for review by OAG and other law enforcement agencies

certificate_requirements.details: Must be provided to every employee who completes the training, including the date taken and course title

risks_or_constraints.impact: Some providers charge a fee per user

notes: Many approved trainings are offered at no cost to ensure broad access for businesses and employees.
